newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular sets record date for spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular sets record date for spin-off.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Tuesday it set May 5 as the record date for a proposed spin-off to shareholders of its wholly owned subsidiary, Vital Images Inc.

According to terms of the proposed transaction, shareholders of Bio-Vascular will receive one share of Vital Images common stock for each two shares of Bio-Vascular common stock owned on that date. There will be no fractional shares issued. Cash will be issued instead of fractional shares.

After receiving approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bio-Vascular said it will determine the effective date for the distribution, at which time Vital Images will become an independent public company. Currently it is expected that the effective date of the distribution will occur in the first half of May, the company said.
Initially, Vital Images is expected to trade in the over-the-counter market on the OTC Bulletin Board. The expected symbol is VTAL.
Bio-Vascular makes and markets specialty medical products for use in thoracic, cardiac, neuro and vascular surgery.
